family.description: This entry represents a domain found in GH172 family of enzymes including DFA I synthase/hydrolase from Bifidobacterium dentium, Exo-alpha-D-arabinofuranosidase from Microbacterium arabinogalactanolyticum and related proteins [[cite:PUB00161976],[cite:PUB00161977],[cite:PUB00161978]]. These proteins contain a pair of homologous structurally similar domains which adopt jelly-roll beta-sandwich. They assemble into trimeric structure that can form other higher order assemblies.
family.name: GH172 second beta-sandwich domain
